theorems.name: Submission.lcmp_measure_le_add_of_open_nhds
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U E : Set (Euclid P)) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → IsCompact E → E ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ν K < ∞) → (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → E ⊆ G → CompactlyContained G U → μ G ≤ ν G + c) → μ E ≤ ν E + c
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
